response.text: The last query's output is the expected AP-side pattern (invoice expense line plus AP line split), so it isn't itself a finding; it was a broad probe. Two items need a closer look: the probable duplicate invoice (452 vs 801), and the invoice-to-journal amount tie-out, which I'll check at the header level by comparing the AP liability line to the invoice amount.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."ACCT_CD", j."CR_AMT", j."DR_AMT" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE TRIM(j."ACCT_CD") IN (SELECT TRIM("ACCT_CD") FROM "GLCOA" WHERE "ACCT_TYP"='LIABILITY') AND ABS(j."CR_AMT"-i."INV_AMT")>0.005 ORDER BY i."INV_ID"
